flight_fire.title: Engine fire scare reported on Bengaluru-Delhi Air India flight
flight_fire.text: An Air India flight from Bengaluru to Delhi was forced to return after passengers reported seeing smoke from the left engine. All 180 passengers were safely evacuated. Airport fire services were deployed immediately.
flight_fire.summary: Engine fire scare on Bengaluru-Delhi flight. 180 passengers evacuated safely. Airport fire response deployed.

flight_fire.title: Smoke seen coming from aircraft engine at Bengaluru airport
flight_fire.text: Eyewitnesses at Kempegowda International Airport reported seeing thick smoke from an aircraft engine during takeoff. The flight was immediately grounded and emergency services rushed to the runway.
flight_fire.summary: Aircraft engine smoke reported at Bengaluru airport during takeoff. Flight grounded, emergency response activated.

flight_fire.title: Air India Bengaluru flight returns due to suspected engine problem
flight_fire.text: Air India flight AI-505 returned to Kempegowda airport within minutes of takeoff following reports of an engine anomaly. DGCA has ordered an investigation. Passengers reported hearing unusual sounds before seeing smoke.
flight_fire.summary: Air India flight returns to Bengaluru due to suspected engine problem. DGCA investigation ordered.

flight_fire.title: Just saw fire trucks racing to KIA runway - anyone know what happened?
flight_fire.text: Multiple fire engines and ambulances heading towards Kempegowda airport runway. Flight appears to have stopped on the runway. Looks like some kind of emergency.
flight_fire.summary: Citizen report: Emergency vehicles racing to airport runway. Possible aircraft emergency.

flight_fire.title: Smoke from plane at Bengaluru airport
flight_fire.text: I can see smoke coming from a plane on the runway at Bengaluru airport. Fire trucks are already there. Lots of people being moved away from the terminal.
flight_fire.summary: Citizen report of smoke from aircraft at Bengaluru airport with emergency response already on scene.

silk_board_flood.title: Waterlogging near Silk Board
silk_board_flood.text: There is waterlogging near Silk Board junction. Vehicles are slowing down and people are unsure if the underpass is safe.

silk_board_flood.title: Traffic stopped near Silk Board underpass
silk_board_flood.text: Heavy congestion reported near Silk Board underpass. Vehicles are stuck and traffic movement is almost stopped.

silk_board_flood.title: Silk Board underpass flooding, avoid the area
silk_board_flood.text: People are saying the Silk Board underpass is flooding. Water level is rising and vehicles are getting stuck. Avoid the route.

silk_board_flood.title: Underpass flooding reported near Silk Board after heavy rainfall
silk_board_flood.text: Local updates mention flooding around Silk Board underpass after heavy rainfall. Commuters have been advised to avoid the junction.

old_airport_road_accident.title: Multi-vehicle accident on Old Airport Road causes massive traffic jam
old_airport_road_accident.text: A multi-vehicle pile-up on Old Airport Road near Domlur has caused a massive traffic jam during morning rush hour. At least three cars and a bus are involved. Multiple people are reported injured and ambulances have been dispatched.
old_airport_road_accident.summary: Multi-vehicle pile-up on Old Airport Road near Domlur. Multiple injuries, ambulances dispatched.

old_airport_road_accident.title: Bad accident near Domlur flyover, people trapped in car
old_airport_road_accident.text: There's been a serious accident near the Domlur flyover on Old Airport Road. A car is badly crushed between a bus and a truck. I think people are still trapped inside. Traffic is completely stopped in both directions.
old_airport_road_accident.summary: Serious accident at Domlur flyover. People possibly trapped in crushed vehicle. Traffic halted.

old_airport_road_accident.title: Ambulances rushing to Old Airport Road accident spot
old_airport_road_accident.text: Just saw three ambulances and two police vehicles rushing towards Old Airport Road near Domlur. There seems to be a major accident. Avoid the area if possible.
old_airport_road_accident.summary: Emergency vehicles responding to major accident on Old Airport Road. Area advised to avoid.
